patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Ocean.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than RocketReach's shape. Choose RocketReach only if your buying job matches “B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights ” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Ocean.io leans data-enrichment, lead-management; RocketReach leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and RocketReach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline.; RocketReach is B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company insights with prospecting automations..
- Workflow coverage skew: Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs RocketReach-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; RocketReach — Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager..

Limitations — Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools; RocketReach: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager.; Essentials is email-only; mobile/direct phones require Pro+..

Poor-fit cases: Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · RocketReach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM pipeline/deal manager. · Avoid Ocean.io if you actually need RocketReach's motion (B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phone numbers, and company)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
